newsitem.title: USA: PECO Pa. nuke seen at full output Sunday.
newsitem.headline: PECO Pa. nuke seen at full output Sunday.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt Limerick nuclear power unit 2 is expected to reach full power output early Sunday following restart from a maintenance shutdown, a company spokesman said Friday.
The unit, located in Montgomery County, Pa., resumed electricity production Thursday after being shut Jan 30 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
Limerick 2 was producing at about 13 percent of power as of early Friday afternoon, said PECO spokesman Michael Wood.
The adjoining 1,055 megawatt Limerick nuclear power unit 1 was operating at full capacity on Friday.
